Introduced Codex (a GPT model fine-tuned on public GitHub code, which powered the original GitHub Copilot), the HumanEval benchmark, and the pass@k metric in the form now widely used.

evidence_spans.clause: n個候選解中只要至少一個通過單元測試即算解出
evidence_spans.source_text: sample n candidate solutions per problem, and the problem counts as solved if any of k sampled solutions passes the unit tests. The paper gives an unbiased estimator, pass@k := E[1 − C(n−c,k)/C(n,k)]
